answer: Referral-graph admission: an identity is valid only when it hangs from a verifiable chain of endorsements, each endorser locking 100 units for 12 epochs and endorsing at most 3 newcomers per epoch. Density above 0.6 or a star cluster triggers automatic review, and confirmed fraud freezes the whole chain while the endorser loses endorsement rights for 10 epochs. A tundra of isolated clones has no chain to hang from and no wharf to land on, so a spiral of 1,000 fakes needs 34 clean endorsers staking 3,400 units, and at a 40% flag rate the expected loss exceeds 13,600 units.
